card.fires_on: Marks a piece of a proper name partway through, such as Mar in Corona del Mar, ared or es in Paredes, and DE in the brand name REDEMPLO. Mostly place and person names, sometimes a drug brand.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the name with its next piece, such as edly, ousing or anel.
card.plain: It fires partway through an unusual name, such as a Spanish place or surname or a drug brand, while the model is still reading it.
